questions.question: Which cellular generation used purely analog transmission?
Which cellular generation first digitized voice and added SMS?
questions.explanation: 2G introduced digital voice via standards like GSM.

questions.question: Which cellular generation runs entirely on IP using LTE?
questions.explanation: 4G LTE is a fully packet-switched, all-IP network.

questions.question: Which multiplexing technique divides a channel into time slots?
questions.explanation: TDM interleaves signals in separate time slices.

questions.question: Which multiplexing technique assigns each signal a different frequency band?
questions.explanation: FDM partitions channel bandwidth into bands.

questions.question: Which multiplexing technique lets all users transmit simultaneously on the same band using unique codes?
questions.explanation: CDMA uses spread-spectrum codes to distinguish users.

questions.question: Which DSL variant provides faster download than upload speed?
questions.explanation: ADSL is asymmetric, favoring downstream bandwidth.

questions.question: Which satellite orbit has the lowest communication latency?
questions.explanation: LEO satellites are closest to Earth, so delay is smallest.

questions.question: Which modulation technique varies the phase of the carrier wave?
questions.explanation: PM shifts carrier phase to encode the signal.

questions.question: What term describes the actual achieved data transfer rate on a link?
questions.explanation: Throughput is the real delivered rate, below bandwidth capacity.

questions.question: What term describes the delay before data reaches its destination?
questions.explanation: Latency measures transmission delay across the network.

questions.question: In ISDN, what do the B channels carry?
questions.explanation: Bearer (B) channels carry user traffic; the D channel carries signaling.

questions.question: Which type of optical fiber supports longer distances using a single light path?
questions.explanation: Single-mode fiber has a narrow core for one light path over long hauls.

questions.question: What is a network where each connection gets a dedicated circuit for the call duration called?
questions.explanation: The PSTN uses circuit switching, reserving a path per call.

questions.question: What variation in packet arrival times disrupts VoIP audio quality?
questions.explanation: Jitter is inconsistent latency that makes VoIP audio choppy.
